note: Two reusable rule candidates emerged from the review findings; no fallow or complaint signal was present.

candidates.text: When a page redesign requires changes to a shared design component, update that component's tests to cover the new behavior and record any new props in the component registry.
candidates.rationale: The tasks redesign forced `Input.svelte` to accept numeric values and `min`/`max` props, but those changes were initially untested and unregistered. Adding tests and updating `components.md` prevents shared-component drift.

candidates.text: If the design system requires full visual control over dropdown menus, use a custom Select component instead of a native `<select>`.
candidates.rationale: Native `<select>` open menus are rendered by the browser/OS and cannot be fully themed. The task editor's closed select matched the design system, but the open menu did not, which was only resolved by accepting the platform limitation.
